quality.counterexample: An app can return HTTP 404 for GET /api/health yet implement browser-visible flows and score; the liveness probe treats HTTPError as success. A different server stack can likewise pass because browser scoring cannot identify Node/Express/SQLite.
quality.suggested_fix: Require successful health response in the verifier and align technology mandates with evidence available to the permitted judge, or remove ungradable mandates.
